headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. The Kansas City Royals dropped a 1-2 decision to the Detroit Tigers, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the Royals' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI. The Chicago Cubs secured a narrow win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a final score of 3-2.

Several players have been impacted by injuries. Tanner Banks, a left-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left forearm strain. Rafael Flores Jr., a catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates, has been placed on the 7-day injured list retroactive to July 23, 2026, with a concussion. Brad Keller, a right-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL tear. Rafael Marchán, a catcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 23, 2026, with left knee patellar tendinitis.

The Kansas City Royals made their first trade of the season, sending CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for Future Considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.
